caption: Pro refreshes registered crops in a selected note folder.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['pdf-crop-refresh'];p.closeReport();p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('pdf-crop-refresh-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow();const results=await p.refreshFolder('PDF Crop Refresh'); if(!results.some(r=>r.status==='Refreshed'))throw new Error('The folder shot has no refreshed crop');p.showReport('Folder refresh (Pro)',results);return 'ok';})()
